same_gpu_findings.periodic: E1/E2 same-GPU benefits are bounded observations on one RTX 5090; short field-unit cost controls used 2 warmups and 5 synchronized timed repeats, whereas complete 2T observations were single executions. Neither qualifies full-coupled or production-scale performance acceptance
same_gpu_findings.e3_short_windows: modest or negative: reported ratios 0.641x, 0.999x, 1.10x, 1.63x and 1.08x; no general scaling claim

preserved_failures.p1_long_fine: E3 long-window p1 kept the same physical H while halving h and doubling M from 256 to 512; its second-round correction-2 line search failed to find a reduction across the 1, 1/2 and 1/4 trials on CPU and GPU

preserved_failures.p2_temporal_separation: p2 passes the M512 same-h field comparison, but the h/h2 iterative/reference-error ratio is about 164.84 and does not qualify temporal separation
